subject: Re: Marketplace listing & regional SKU/localization decisions
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@aws-partners.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell + marketplace packaging for DataViz Labs opportunity

Hi Irene / Jonas,

Following up on our call this morning — thanks for the context on the DataViz Labs POC. AWS strategy folks asked for a concise mapping of which Redwood SKUs we intend to publish in the AWS Marketplace for the first launch (and how we want them packaged for co-sell eligibility).

Attached: AWS_CoSell_Guidelines.pdf (high-level).

Quick asks from AWS side:
- A primary SKU for Hosted (pay-as-you-go) that matches your Hosted API offering
- 1 or 2 Reserve/Commit SKUs (monthly/annual) for Dedicated capacity — must include unit of measure and billing cadence
- A Private Deployment SKU (bring-your-own infra) for partners that will need billing via marketplace but non-hosted delivery
- Regional availability: confirm whether we will list in us-east-1/us-west-2 and EU (eu-west-1) at launch; GovCloud is a separate discussion

Can you share a draft SKU mapping + region matrix by EOD Wednesday? If easier, we can run a 30-min workshop with the AWS marketplace team and your product ops to finalize.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Miller
Partner Programs, AWS Marketplace
[sample signature]

Attachments: AWS_CoSell_Guidelines.pdf

From: irene_choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@aws-partners.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell + marketplace packaging for DataViz Labs opportunity

Sarah — thanks, this is helpful. Draft mapping attached (redwood_sku-localization_v1.xlsx). High level thoughts below so we can iterate quickly: 

Summary recommendation (starter launch):
- Hosted (public API) SKU: "Redwood Inference - Hosted (on-demand)" — list in US (us-east-1, us-west-2) + EU (eu-west-1). Pricing: per-token buckets; match hosted public pricing but with marketplace fees baked in.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) SKU: "Redwood Dedicated - Monthly Commit" — two commit sizes (S / M) to simplify co-sell quoting. Billing cadence monthly, meter = vGPU-hours. Initially restrict to US + EU; expand APAC after partner certification.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) SKU: "Redwood Private - Enterprise License" — seat/instance baseline with a marketplace billing wrapper for procurement only (no runtime in AWS). List globally but mark regions as "delivery: private".

Region & packaging nuance: 
- AWS: prioritize us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for launch. us-west-2 as secondary. GovCloud: only after SOC2 + FedRAMP assessment — timeline Q4.
- Azure: mirror AWS choices but package Dedicated as "dedicated units" (Azure meter constraints); need to coordinate with Amit on meter ids.
- GCP: recommend launching with Hosted + Private only initially (no Dedicated) because GCP co-sell plumbing for reserved GPU SKUs is immature for partners.

Open questions for the workshop:
- Do we want 2 commit sizes or 3? (tradeoff: simpler quoting vs covering large enterprise TCO)
- How do we represent free trial / credits in marketplace listings so it flows into co-sell motions?
- Any legal procurement constraints for EU public sector?

Next steps I propose: workshop with AWS + Azure + internal product ops to finalize SKU spreadsheet and legal ops checklist. I can host Wed 8/5 or Thu 8/6 10–11am PT.

— Irene Choi
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene.ch@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@aws-partners.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell + marketplace packaging for DataViz Labs opportunity

Thanks Irene — a few practical constraints from Ops/Finance I've captured inline: 

> Hosted (public API) SKU: ... Pricing: per-token buckets; match hosted public pricing but with marketplace fees baked in.
- Ops: marketplace listing needs stable SKU IDs and a standard meter—recommend 3 per-token tiers (dev / basic / enterprise) to map to existing pricing tiers.

> Dedicated (reserved capacity) SKU: ... two commit sizes (S / M)
- Finance asks for clear usage ceilings on S to avoid unexpected overrun billing. If we do 2 SKUs we must ensure upgrade path is documented and automated (work with billing team).

> GCP: recommend launching with Hosted + Private only initially
- Agree. GCP quotas and custom meter negotiation takes longer. Keeping it out of the initial Dedicated launch reduces risk.

Also:
- Need a short legal addendum for marketplace terms (I'll draft a one-page) — legal ops wants to see it before we publish.
- Product wants telemetry hooks so partners can surface usage for co-sell motion (HubSpot event + partner report).

If we run the workshop, I'll bring the SKU workbook and a sample price mapping. Prefer Wed 8/5 10am PT.

— Jonas
Director, Product Ops

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@aws-partners.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell + marketplace packaging for DataViz Labs opportunity

Irene / Jonas — this looks reasonable. A few AWS-side notes: 

- Co-sell eligibility: we need the Hosted SKU plus a minimum commit SKU to qualify for some co-sell incentives — two commit sizes is fine.
- Marketplace metadata: include exact product descriptions and allowable marketplace discounts. I'll send a template after this email.
- GovCloud: we can parallel-track assessments, but GovCloud listing will require separate compliance artifacts.

We should do the workshop — Wed 8/5 10am PT works for me. Proposed agenda attached (Joint_Workshop_Agenda.docx).

Also attaching a DocuSign draft for a mutual MOU to synchronize listing timelines: DocuSign_MoU_Link.txt (link to external DocuSign).

See you Wednesday — Sarah

Attachments: Joint_Workshop_Agenda.docx, DocuSign_MoU_Link.txt

Thanks everyone — confirming the workshop for Wed 2026-08-05 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. Agenda looks good.

I uploaded the SKU workbook with comments to the shared drive (link above) and added a suggested legal addendum draft (see comment tab). Action items before the workshop: 
- Jonas: circulate price tier mapping and draft legal addendum (EOD Tue).
- Marcus: coordinate with Billing to confirm meters and usage ceilings for Dedicated SKUs.
- Sarah: send the AWS marketplace metadata template and the co-sell checklist.

I'll prepare a one-page mutual action plan we can sign in DocuSign after the workshop; if we can get the MOU signed by 8/12, we can target a marketplace publish window of 9/1 for Hosted + initial Dedicated SKUs in US/EU.

— Irene
